---
title: "Command line"
---

scjn has one verb, `download`: it puts a release on disk, in the package's
cache directory, so that every reader in `scjn.release` then reads off it with
no network request at all.

```bash
scjn --version
scjn download [--collection {laws,regulations,guidelines,treaties,bylaws}]
              [--slug SLUG | --id ID] [--all] [--cache-dir DIR] [--refresh]
```

The index is always downloaded. Assets already cached are matched by name and
never revalidated, so a second run costs no download at all.

## `--version`

Prints the installed version and exits.

```bash
scjn --version
```

## `--collection`

Which collection to download. The values are English; each one names a release:

| `--collection` | Release | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `laws` (the default) | `scjn-leyes` | the federal laws |
| `regulations` | `scjn-reglamentos` | the federal regulations (*reglamentos*) |
| `guidelines` | `scjn-lineamientos` | the federal guidelines (*lineamientos*) |
| `treaties` | `scjn-tratados` | the international treaties |
| `bylaws` | `scjn-estatutos` | the federal instruments the SCJN classifies `ESTATUTO` |

```bash
scjn download
scjn download --collection treaties
```

## `--slug`

Only this law's tarball, by slug. Repeatable, and valid with `--collection
laws` only. Not given: every law the release publishes.

```bash
scjn download --slug lfca --slug cpeum
```

## `--id`

Only this instrument's tarball, by `id_ordenamiento`. Repeatable, and valid
with `--collection regulations`, `guidelines`, `treaties` or `bylaws` only. Not
given: every instrument the release publishes.

```bash
scjn download --collection regulations --id 104906
```

## `--all`

Every collection, whole: the five releases, several thousand tarballs. It
cannot be combined with `--collection`, `--slug` or `--id`. A collection added
to the package later is downloaded too.

```bash
scjn download --all
```

## `--cache-dir`

The directory to write into. Not given: `scjn.cache.CACHE_DIR`, the
OS-appropriate per-user cache, overridable with `$SCJN_CACHE_DIR`.

```bash
scjn download --slug lfca --cache-dir ./cache
```

## `--refresh`

Re-download assets already present instead of keeping them.

```bash
scjn download --slug lfca --refresh
```

## What the developer docs' examples read

The verified examples of the [developer docs](https://legistlan.github.io/scjn/dev/)
run against three cached assets, put there by:

```bash
scjn download --slug lfca
scjn download --collection regulations --id 104906
scjn download --collection bylaws --id 111330
```

The last line of a run says what happened, for example
`scjn-leyes: 1 assets in <cache dir> (1 downloaded, 0 already cached)`.
